info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Consumer Advisory Services Update API
info.description: The Consumer Advisory Services Update API allows users to modify existing consumer advisory records to reflect the latest information and recommendations. This API is essential for financial institutions and advisory firms that need to keep their advisory data current and relevant to their customers. By using this endpoint, users can update specific advisory service details, ensuring that consumers receive the most accurate guidance. Typical consumers of this API include financial advisors and banks that aim to enhance their client service offerings.

patch.description: This endpoint allows developers to update the details of a specific consumer advisory service identified by its unique resource ID. Ensure to provide the necessary data fields in the request to modify the service effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the consumer advisory services details related to the specified RES-100045 service. Please ensure that the payload adheres to the defined schema for successful processing.

200.description: The request was successful, and the resource has been updated.
